Because: Bold, Loud.</div><div class="odv-decs"><div class="odv-dec"><span class="odv-dec-what"><span class="odv-kind">Rule</span>Paragraph or help text: type.body, short<small>Not Long paragraphs.</small></span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></div><div class="odv-dec"><span class="odv-dec-what"><span class="odv-kind">Rule</span>A button label: A short verb that moves: Join, Try, Go<small>Not &quot;Learn more&quot;.</small></span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></div><div class="odv-dec"><span class="odv-dec-what"><span class="odv-kind">Rule</span>A success message: Celebrate, briefly<small>Not A long thank-you.</small></span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></div><div class="odv-dec"><span class="odv-dec-what"><span class="odv-kind">Rule</span>An empty state: Playful, with a clear next step<small>Not A dead end.</small></span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></div><div class="odv-dec"><span class="odv-dec-what"><span class="odv-kind">Rule</span>A first visit: One bold line and one button<small>Not A paragraph of copy.</small></span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></div><div class="odv-dec"><span class="odv-dec-what"><span class="odv-kind">Variant</span>Toast tone success<small>Celebrate, briefly: You're on the list.
